services.title: Our Services
services.description: Comprehensive banking solutions for individuals and businesses worldwide.
services.pageSubtitle: From personal accounts to business banking, we have everything you need to manage your finances globally.
services.personalDesc: Open a personal account in minutes with competitive rates, global access, and no hidden fees. Enjoy free international transactions, mobile check deposit, and round-the-clock access to your funds from anywhere in the world.
services.businessDesc: Tailored solutions for businesses of all sizes, from startups to enterprises. Accept payments in multiple currencies, manage payroll, automate invoicing, and access working capital financing with flexible terms.
services.transfersDesc: Send money to 150+ countries with competitive exchange rates, low fees, and real-time tracking. Schedule recurring transfers, set rate alerts, and convert currencies at live mid-market rates.
services.cardsDesc: Premium cards with worldwide acceptance, unlimited rewards points, and exclusive travel benefits. Enjoy airport lounge access, purchase protection, and zero foreign transaction fees on all purchases.
services.supportDesc: Our dedicated support team is available 24/7 via live chat, phone, and email. Get instant assistance in over 10 languages from our global support centers in North America, Europe, and Asia.
services.securityDesc: Bank-grade 256-bit encryption and biometric multi-factor authentication protect every transaction. Real-time fraud monitoring, automatic session timeouts, and a zero-liability guarantee ensure your money stays safe.

footer.tagline: Secure global banking at your fingertips.

about.pageSubtitle: Empowering global commerce through secure, accessible banking since 2020.
about.storyText: International Western Bank was founded in 2020 with a bold mission: to make global banking as simple and accessible as local banking. Our founders, veterans of international finance and technology, recognized that sending money across borders was still too slow, expensive, and opaque for most people and businesses. They set out to build a modern financial platform from the ground up — one that leverages the latest in cloud infrastructure, encryption technology, and regulatory expertise to deliver a truly borderless banking experience. Today, IWB serves over 10,000 customers in 150+ countries, processing more than $50 million in transfers annually. We have grown from a small startup to a trusted financial partner, but our mission remains the same: empower every person and business to participate fully in the global economy.
about.missionText: To provide seamless, secure, and accessible banking services that empower individuals and businesses to transact across borders without friction. We believe that everyone deserves access to global financial services, regardless of location or background. Our mission drives every decision we make, from the technology we build to the partnerships we forge across the globe.
about.visionText: A world where financial borders no longer exist. Where sending money across continents is as easy as sending a message. Where every business, regardless of size, can compete globally on a level playing field. We are building the infrastructure to make this vision a reality for millions of people worldwide.
about.value1Desc: With a presence in over 150 countries and support for 50+ currencies, we connect people and businesses across every continent. Our global network ensures your money moves as freely as you do.
about.value2Desc: We protect your assets with bank-grade encryption, biometric authentication, and proactive fraud detection. Our security infrastructure is audited regularly by leading third-party firms.
about.value3Desc: Every product we build starts with our customers' needs. Our 24/7 multilingual support team resolves issues fast, and our satisfaction ratings consistently rank among the best in fintech.
about.value4Desc: We invest continuously in cutting-edge technology to make banking faster, smarter, and more accessible. From AI-powered fraud prevention to instant cross-border payments, innovation is at our core.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose IWB
whyChoose.item1Desc: Your security is our foundation. We employ military-grade encryption, continuous monitoring, and strict access controls to safeguard every transaction and every dollar you entrust to us.
whyChoose.item2Desc: Send and receive money in over 50 currencies across 150+ countries. Competitive exchange rates, transparent fees, and fast settlement times make international banking effortless.
whyChoose.item3Desc: Our award-winning customer support team is available 24/7 in 10+ languages. Whether by phone, live chat, or email, we are here to help whenever you need us.

contact.pageSubtitle: We are here to help. Reach out to our team for any inquiries or support.
